name: Hold My Hand (Or Let Go)
source:
Experience the story of Charlie, a completely normal Swedish college student that’s graduating next week. But before he does that, he has to say goodbye to all the friends that he made during his three years in town.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4845540/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
体验查理的故事，他是一位完全正常的瑞典大学生，下周即将毕业。但在此之前，他必须向他在城里三年里结识的所有朋友道别。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4845540/]Steam[/url]]
